senses.when: governing a SINGULAR verb or adjective
senses.note: Morphologically plural (Ncmpa in all 55 attested forms) but takes singular agreement — Gen 1:1 has plural אלהים with singular ברא. The grammar, not theology, is what selects this sense.

senses.when: plural agreement, or a plural modifier such as אחרים
senses.note: Same word. Exod 20:3 has אלהים אחרים — a plural adjective, so a plural sense.
Ps 82:1 has אלהים standing in an assembly and being judged BY אלהים — the same word in both roles inside one verse, so one of the two cannot be the singular God.
A live reading in judicial contexts. STATED, NOT PREFERRED: for Ps 82 the grammar does not settle between this and the divine-council sense, so both are carried.

unresolved: Ps 82 cannot be resolved on grammar alone between "gods", "divine beings" and "judges". All three stand.
